messages.subject: Re: can't find /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf
parts:
Here are the contents of the default config:
https://raw.github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/master/config/default.config

You'll need to create the /etc/shiny-server directory and /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf yourself.

On Saturday, June 22, 2013, Michele wrote:
Just found out that I have two shiny-server.conf at these locations:
  1. /etc/init/shiny-server.conf
  2. /usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/config/upstart/shiny-server.conf

the server is running with the default values and I wonder which of the above I need to modify or if I need to create a

/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf
